task_instance: Set up the skill's documented SQLite debug-log store (exact logs table schema + 5 indexes), populate it with realistic structured frontend log entries including a seeded checkout failure flow (trace_id, a slow payment API warning, and a DB-timeout error) plus repeated form-validation errors, then run the skill's AI-friendly triage workflow end-to-end: overview-by-level counts, time range, recent errors, component/route narrowing, follow-the-trace-id flow, slow-operation detection via json_extract(duration_ms), and error clustering by event. Verify each query returns the correct triage result.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r027. Created build_logs.py (builds logs/debug.sqlite with the SKILL.md 'Minimal schema' logs table and all five documented indexes on timestamp/level/event/component/route, deriving component from the event prefix exactly as the skill describes) and triage.py (runs the skill's query patterns). Ran: `python3 -I build_logs.py` -> inserted 10 rows; `python3 -I triage.py`. Verified results: overview GROUP BY level = debug 1 / error 3 / info 5 / warn 1; recent-errors query returned the 3 errors newest-first; follow-trace-id 'abc-123' reconstructed the full checkout flow in time order (started -> api.request.start -> api.request.slow warn -> paymentProcessed -> cart.checkout.failed error), correctly pinpointing the failure root cause; slow-operations query via json_extract(data,'$.duration_ms')>1000 isolated the 3200ms payment call; error-cluster GROUP BY event showed form.submit.validationError x2 (intermittent) and cart.checkout.failed x1; event LIKE 'api.request.%' prefix filter and route LIKE '/settings%' filter both returned correct rows; pragma_index_list confirmed all 5 indexes exist. Persistence verified: the on-disk logs/debug.sqlite file was written by one process and read back by a separate process. Notes on runtime fit: the skill's named helpers are not part of this runtime's guaranteed software -- the `sqlite3` command-line binary is not installed, and the bundled ingestion server (examples/log-server.ts) is written for the Bun JavaScript runtime (bun:sqlite / Bun.serve), which the runtime definition (python3+libraries, node, git, common CLI tools) does not grant; per the rules I did not rewrite that bundled server. The core deliverable -- a persistent, structured, queryable SQLite debug-log store driving the skill's AI-friendly token-efficient triage -- was produced and verified on the identical SQLite engine (format 3.45.1) using python3's built-in sqlite3 library and the skill's own portable SQL, so the queries and schema behave exactly as documented; the missing CLI only affects output-formatting flags (-column/-json/-line), not the deliverable. All work stayed inside the work directory; no network, no installs, no connectors used.
